_comment: Error cases the sidecar documents in ml/README.md (## Errors) and must keep speaking.
tests/test_contract.py drives this table against the real app, so a case that stops
mapping to its documented code fails here rather than in a caller. Keep it in step with
the README table: it is the executable half of that table.
Fields: id (test name suffix), method, path, request (one of raw/json/files), status,
code. `raw` is sent as UTF-8 bytes with `content_type`; `json` is sent as a JSON body;
`files` is sent as multipart with the given filename and content type.
Cases that need an environment override (the size ceilings) stay as explicit tests in
test_contract.py, because their point is the monkeypatched limit, not the route.
